storyHeading: The easy way to join a group trip
storyParagraphs: You may already know where you want to go. The awkward part is finding people whose calendars match yours. Fixed departure trips give you a planned date, a shared route and fellow travellers to meet along the way. You can arrive solo, with a friend or as a small group and still have company for the good views and the long drives.

Before you book, we explain the route, dates, stay choices and what the quote covers. Comfort Journey was founded in Bhopal by Sharad Kumar Mishra in 1992. It has a 4.8 Google rating from 85+ reviews, plus real people on WhatsApp and phone support at +91 92039 31912. During your trip, the team remains available 24/7.

Every itinerary can be customised. For a fixed departure, the date and shared route define the group plan, while hotel level, room preferences and selected arrangements can be discussed before booking. Ask about 3-star to 5-star hotels, palaces or villas, private cabs with drivers and visa assistance for international trips.

quickAnswer.question: What is a fixed departure group tour?
quickAnswer.answer: A fixed departure group tour has a published date and shared route, so you can join other travellers while our team handles the planning. Comfort Journey confirms the current package, inclusions and quote on WhatsApp. The route and date are fixed for the group, while hotel level, room preferences and selected arrangements may be discussed for your needs.

faqs.q: How do fixed departure group tours work?
faqs.a: You choose a package and ask for the next available dates. We share the planned route, inclusions and current seat information before you decide. The date and group route form the fixed part; suitable personal requests can be discussed.

faqs.q: Can I join a fixed departure trip alone?
faqs.a: Yes. Solo travellers can ask to join a shared group and meet fellow travellers along the route. Tell us about your room preference and comfort needs when you enquire, so we can explain the available options.

faqs.q: What can I change on a fixed departure tour?
faqs.a: The published date and shared route are the starting plan. Every itinerary can be customised, so ask about hotel level, room type, private cabs with drivers or other practical details. We will tell you what fits that departure before you book.

faqs.q: How much does a fixed departure group tour cost?
faqs.a: The price changes with the destination, travel dates, hotel level, room type, transport, visa needs and what the package includes. We share an exact quote on WhatsApp after understanding your dates and preferences. Ask us at +91 92039 31912 for current options.

faqs.q: Do you offer international fixed departure trips?
faqs.a: Yes, the catalogue includes international trips such as Vietnam, Bali, Thailand and Dubai. Visa assistance is available for international travel. Ask us to confirm current departure dates, inclusions and the documents needed for your trip.

faqs.q: What support do I get during the trip?
faqs.a: You can reach real people on WhatsApp or phone at +91 92039 31912. The team is available 24/7 during trips for practical questions and help with arrangements. Travel details and inclusions are explained before departure.

finalHeading: Find a date that fits your plans
finalText: Tell us the place, dates and number of travellers. We will share the next suitable group trip, clear inclusions and an exact WhatsApp quote.
